text:
Nadia P: quick flag — a handful of restore jobs from our archived object snapshots are failing with KMS decrypt errors after we migrated instance profiles to OIDC principals yesterday. 3/90 failed in the last 30m.
Theo: seeing it. Error: "NotAuthorizedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222333444:key/ark-55" on restore job r-711.
Ravi: did the instance-profile arn change shape? OIDC roles use a different principal format. KMS grants are tied to exact grantee ARN.
Nadia P: yes we replaced ec2-role/data-mover with oidc-role:data-mover-main and updated IAM policies but left CMKs untouched.
encops-bot: Alert: 3 decrypt failures for key ark-55 between 2025-12-02T18:10:45Z and 2025-12-02T18:12:10Z. Sample log:
```
2025-12-02T18:11:03Z restore-runner ERROR job=r-711 cause=AccessDenied kmsKey=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222333444:key/ark-55
CausedBy: NotAuthorizedException: User arn:aws:sts::222333444:assumed-role/oidc-role:data-mover-main is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```
Theo: inventory shows grants on ark-55 point to arn:aws:iam::222333444:role/ec2-role/data-mover (old). Since grants are immutable they're now orphaned.
Ravi: mitigation: 1) create scoped CreateGrant for the new oidc-role with EncryptionContextSubset for snapshot ids, 2) temporarily add the new role to the key policy (broad), or 3) replay restores from an instance using the old principal (hard).
Nadia P: do 1) targeted grants with short retire windows and log CloudTrail events. Capture GrantIds in an incident ticket. Also add a runbook item to detect grants referencing old ARN patterns.
Theo: running create-grant for snap-202312-05 with constraint now:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id ark-55 --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::222333444:assumed-role/oidc-role:data-mover-main --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"snapshot_id":"snap-202312-05"} --name temp-restore-202312-05
```
Response: GrantId g-omega-7.
Ravi: replays succeeded for the three failures. I'll retire the temp grants after verification and attach CloudTrail CreateGrant/RetireGrant entries to INC-2025-1291.
sec-oncall: compliance ok if grants are scoped, retired quickly, and operator + reason are recorded. Also require CloudTrail retention to cover these actions.
Nadia P: follow-ups: add a preflight check to the IAM/infra migration playbook to query kms_grants for matching grantee ARNs, add an automated detector to flag orphaned grants, and prefer using key-policy statements where appropriate to avoid per-role grants churn.
Theo: also note cross-account copies exist for some snapshots; we'll need partner coordination if their principals were affected.
Nadia P: status: 3 failures -> 0 after scoped grants and replays. Monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
